question: Do the frozen Module 1 paired final-score labels and Module 2 regulation-offensive-series and separate overtime labels agree exactly with independently double-entered official NFL gamebooks?

includedTargets: Module 1 official final home and away score, including overtime
Module 2 home and away regulation offensive-series counts
Module 2 home and away overtime offensive-series counts
Module 2 edge-case treatment and offense attribution
excludedTargets: drive outcomes or drive-state labels reserved for R4
model predictions, features, coefficients, losses, or promotion results
scope.truthSource: Exact official NFL gamebook PDF bytes from an nfl.com or static.www.nfl.com origin. nflverse, model artifacts, game-center summaries, media reports, and third-party stat sites are not truth sources.
comparisonSources: Frozen Module 2 v8 regulation and overtime target labels

targetDefinitions.finalScore: The gamebook final home and away points, including overtime, matching the frozen Module 1 estimand.
targetDefinitions.regulationOffensiveSeries: For each team, count a series only when quarters 1 through 4 contain at least one live pass, run, quarterback kneel, quarterback spike, punt, field-goal attempt, or qualifying live aborted snap by that offense. Kicks, returns, tries, penalty-only and no-play records do not create a series. A punt or field-goal attempt counts for the offense taking the snap. Defensive and special-teams scores do not create a series for the scoring team. Kneel-only terminal series count.
targetDefinitions.overtime: Record overtime occurrence and each team's overtime offensive-series count separately. No overtime series may enter the regulation count.
targetDefinitions.edgeTreatment: For the sampled event, record whether it creates a series, the attributed offense if it does, the quarter, and the official gamebook play/drive reference.

sampling.universe: All 4,175 completed NFL regular-season games in the frozen 2010-2025 schedule/source manifest used by Module 2 v8.
sampling.rankingRule: Within each eligible stratum, rank ascending by SHA-256 of UTF-8 seed + NUL + stratum_id + NUL + game_id; take the first not already selected. No outcome or discrepancy may alter the order.

priorityOrder.allocation: For each season 2010-2025, one game from weeks 1-9 and one game from weeks 10 through the season's final regular-season week. Previously selected and pilot-excluded games are skipped by the frozen ranking.

sampling.edgeSelectorContract: A standalone sampling script may use only the frozen schedule and play-by-play comparison cache to identify selector candidates. It may not import or call Module 1 or Module 2 reconstruction/modeling code. The selected event reference is for sampling and later comparison, never official truth.

pilotExclusions.reason: NFL game-center URL-format pilot exposed its public score before preregistration; it cannot enter the audit sample.
NFL game-center URL-format pilot exposed its public score before preregistration; it cannot enter the audit sample.

otherExclusions: Any game outside the frozen 2010-2025 completed regular-season universe
sampling.replacementRule: There is no outcome-based replacement. If a nonmandatory ranked candidate lacks an official NFL gamebook before review, take the next ranked candidate in the same frozen stratum and retain a source-unavailable audit row. If a mandatory six-game census item lacks an official gamebook, or a stratum cannot reach its allocation, the protocol is invalid. Once either reviewer opens a selected gamebook, that game cannot be replaced or excluded.
sampling.deduplicationRule: The priority order produces 64 unique games. A game already selected is skipped for later strata; its earlier stratum flags remain.

rules: Reviewer A and Reviewer B must be distinct natural persons and must enter all 64 gamebooks independently.
Neither reviewer may inspect nflverse target values, model artifacts, the other reviewer's entries, discrepancy output, or adjudication before both complete entry files are frozen and hashed.
The adjudicator must be a third natural person who did not make either initial entry. The adjudicator sees anonymized disagreements only after both entry hashes are frozen.

An AI assistant may prepare manifests, retrieve and hash official gamebooks, validate blank schemas, and compute agreement after unblinding, but cannot impersonate an independent human reviewer or adjudicator.
Reviewer identities may be pseudonymous in the public artifact, but a private signed role-attestation hash must bind one person to one role before review.
reviewerIndependence.blockedRule: If three independent natural-person roles are not available, R1 stops at reviewer_independence_blocked and R2 is protocol_invalid. Automated agreement or repeated entry by one person cannot substitute.

rules: Use only the hashed official gamebook assigned in the sample manifest.
Enter integer counts; blanks are incomplete, not zero.
For non-overtime games, enter overtime_occurred=0 and both overtime counts=0.
For edge fields not assigned to the game, enter NOT_ASSIGNED.
Raw entry files are append-frozen after hashing and are never edited during reconciliation.

adjudication.trigger: Any Reviewer A versus Reviewer B field disagreement or either reviewer's explicit AMBIGUOUS flag.
rules: Create an anonymized discrepancy row preserving both raw values and their hashes.
The third adjudicator re-reads the same hashed official gamebook and records truth, page/play support, and a discrepancy taxonomy.
No majority vote and no consultation of nflverse/model labels is allowed during adjudication.
If the official gamebook cannot resolve the target under the frozen definition, mark official_truth_unresolved; do not drop or impute the row.
Only after adjudicated truth is frozen and hashed may a separate script reveal and compare the existing source/model labels.

preadjudicationReviewerAgreement: Exact match rate by target family
Mean and maximum absolute difference for count fields
Cohen kappa for overtime occurrence when defined
Wilson 95 percent interval for each exact match rate
adjudicatedTargetAgreement: Exact match rate by target family
Mean and maximum absolute error for count fields
Cohen kappa for overtime occurrence when defined
Wilson 95 percent interval for each exact match rate
Discrepancy and severe-error counts by frozen taxonomy

unitOfAnalysis.overtimeSeries: 128 team-game count cells, with zero for non-overtime games
unitOfAnalysis.edgeTreatment: 20 assigned edge instances: 14 ontology selectors plus the six multi-offense census games

definition: Any adjudicated regulation-series mismatch of two or more for either team
Any overtime series merged into regulation or any regulation series assigned to overtime
Any edge instance assigned to the wrong offense or treated as creating/dropping a series contrary to the frozen ontology
Any reviewer-independence, blinding, source-hash, sample-allocation, or post-review replacement violation

thresholds.decisionRule: R1 passes only if both the review-process gate and every adjudicated target gate pass. Any failure returns protocol_invalid and blocks R2 until a new target/review decision is preregistered. No correction may be made in place and no favorable subset may be reported as a pass.

knownPreFreezeSourceDiscovery.statement: Before this hash, URL-format discovery exposed game-center scores for the two pilot-excluded regular-season games above and a search snippet for a 2009-season postseason-excluded gamebook. No selected regular-season gamebook was manually reviewed, no possession count was extracted, and no comparison discrepancy was computed.
knownPreFreezeSourceDiscovery.effect: The two regular-season pilots are frozen out of sampling; the postseason game was outside the universe before discovery.
